data.reasoning: Both models agree that the executable files (PKGBUILD, geninfo.sh) are safe and use standard AUR patterns for split packages. The only disagreement stems from an API error in the Qwen model when reviewing non-executable files (LICENSE, REUSE.toml). DeepSeek successfully reviewed all files and found no security issues.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by an LLM API error (HTTP 400) in the Qwen model when processing LICENSE and REUSE.toml, forcing an 'inconclusive' result. There is no actual security disagreement between the models.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to audit LICENSE and REUSE.toml due to an API error.
learnings: The audit tool should handle API errors gracefully. If a model fails to audit non-executable files (like licenses or metadata), it should not force the entire package verdict to 'inconclusive'. The tool should either retry the request or exclude non-executable files from the final verdict calculation.
